blocks.text: BEIJING, China—A Chinese court sentenced three members of a criminal gang to death on Tuesday for operating a network of brutal scam centers in Myanmar‘s Kokang region on the border with China. The court also sent to jail dozens more persons. China has stepped up cooperation with Southeast Asian nations to crack down on a vast industry that has flourished in the region in recent years to fleece people out of billions of dollars. Those conducting the online scams are sometimes willing con artists, and other times trafficked foreigners — many Chinese — tricked themselves into work and held in prison-like compounds. […]...
